purpose: Validate the structure and internal invariants of one declared SpaceClaim runtime report on the host.
trigger: One structured runtime report is available for a host-side schema check.

inputs.name: report_path
inputs.description: Path to one UTF-8 JSON runtime report.

preconditions: report_path identifies one readable UTF-8 JSON object within the host input-size limit.
The caller treats report-declared runtime and geometry states as claims, not independent observations.

outputs.name: schema_validation_result
outputs.description: One passed or failed result with stable structural issue codes.

postconditions: A passed result means only that the report structure and internal invariants are valid.
No report field is upgraded into independently observed SpaceClaim evidence.

implementation.target_environment: Host Python 3.9 or newer; invoke without --contract and do not launch SpaceClaim.
implementation.notes: This operation runs only the report-structure path of the shared validator.

ambiguity_checks: No geometry object is selected; only report fields and internal invariants are checked.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable because the operation has no geometry effect.

failure_modes.condition: The report cannot be read, decoded, or parsed as one JSON object.
failure_modes.detection: Load report_path with the bounded UTF-8 JSON loader.
failure_modes.safe_state: The report remains untrusted and the result is failed.

failure_modes.condition: The report violates a required field, type, range, uniqueness, path, or evidence-state invariant.
failure_modes.detection: Run validate_structure and retain every stable issue code.
failure_modes.safe_state: The report remains untrusted and the result is failed.

recovery.action: Provide one readable UTF-8 JSON report and rerun this operation.
Repair or regenerate the report from its source and rerun this operation.

validation.method: Run the targeted report-validator tests over valid and malformed reports without supplying a contract.
validation.expected: Valid structure passes and each malformed report returns a stable issue code without an exception.

evidence_refs.notes: The single-action schema-validation boundary was reviewed.

design_only.notes: The operation validates report structure only.

evidence_refs.notes: Targeted host tests cover schema-only validation behavior.

geometry_measurements.notes: Declared values are not independently measured.

visual_review.notes: No viewport or image is reviewed.

evidence_level.notes: Evidence stops at design_only and host_checked.
